description.text: Department of Art Department of Art has many years of teaching experience. It has a group of qualified teachers. In addition, this department possesses advanced equipments, such as drawing room, costume designing room, photography room, environment and art room, portrait room, etc. In teaching program, the department adopts module-oriented course construction and forms a specialized education system. Artistic word, vast world!

duration.text: The Art at Qingdao Hismile College is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
